plan: Boost + rotation (surge exit, whipsaw switch (the whole account into TLT, GLD or SPY) with the rate/gold regime, TLT / GLD by 6-month gain, narrow-market cash week read from the equal-weight index’s full history, lower-high exit into gold or bonds on both its triggers, no T-bills: gold or bonds if up over 3 months, else DBMF managed futures (from its start in May 2019; cash before); price-break rule: the day SPY closes under its 100-day average for the first time with that average and its 7-day average both falling, the haven pick for 10 sessions; rebound rule: stays in stocks after a 12%+ drop with gold or bonds up 2%+ and a daily higher low; fading-energy filter: a top-5 stock whose volume and daily swings have both faded isn’t bought, its slot stays in cash; the whipsaw check counts the list with the filter off)
previous: the same plan without the price-break rule (default until Oct 24, 2026)
